text_block_list.name: Mio
text_block_list.text:
Wahh! Huh? Huh?!
These enemies... look like us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ！　
え？　
えっ！？
私たちのそっくりさん……？

text_block_list.name: Uzuki
text_block_list.text:
F-fighting myself is one thing,
but I don't like the idea of fighting against Rin and Mio...
text_block_list.orig_text:
じ、
自分はともかく、
リンちゃんやミオちゃんと戦うのは
なんだか気が引けます……

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Uzuki, those things aren't us, so don't hold back.
In fact, they creep me out a bit. Let's get rid of them quickly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウヅキ、
これは私たちじゃないから
遠慮はいらないよ。
むしろちょっと不気味だし……
とっととやっつけちゃおう！
